en: Sepia-toned historic postcard view over the rooftops of a small European town set in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are narrow houses with steep tiled roofs and a small, fenced garden or courtyard with pillars and ornamental plants. In the middle distance, more compact buildings form the old town, and in the background a church tower with a bulbous spire rises above the rooftops. Smokestacks and open countryside can be seen further back. Printed German text appears at the top of the card.
